items.text: thoda time milega
kal tak payment
split karna hai
haan sahi
ji bilkul
thik hai

items.context: Kab tak payment kar payenge aap?
items.text: kal tak chal jayega
ji thoda waqt chahiye
haan bhai thik hai
main kal tak pura payment kar dunga
agar possible ho to thoda aur time de do
kya hum payment ko do hisso mein baant sakte hain
main April mein paise arrange kar lunga bhaiya
thoda jaldi karna padega payment karne ke liye
overdue payment ke liye thoda aur time milega kya
mere paas is samay paise nahi hain thoda wait kar lo

items.context: Aapko payment karne ke liye kitna extension chahiye?
items.text: ji main thoda waqt chahata hoon payment ke liye

items.context: Kya aap payment split karwana chahte hain?
items.text: kya main installment mein payment kar sakta hoon

items.context: Kab tak payment kar denge aap?
items.text: main Agle mahine hi payment fix kar dunga

items.context: Kya aapko bill ke details clear hain?
items.text: mujhe apke bill mein thoda samajhne ka samay chahiye

items.context: Extension ke liye aapka request kya hai?
items.text: ji thoda waqt dene ka krod nivedan karta hoon
bhaiya main thoda financial problem mein hoon isliye payment karne mein samay lag jayega
kya aap log thoda time aur de sakte hain payment complete karne ke liye
main apne salary aane ke baad hi pura payment bhej dunga thoda extension dena
agar aap log payment split karne dein to main pehla hissa abhi bhej doon
maine jo due rakha hai uska thoda part main abhi clear kar dunga aur baaki baad mein
kya aap log payment schedule mein kuch change kar sakte hain mujhe help chahiye
mere paas current mein itna paisa nahi hai main thoda aur samay chahata hoon baaki dene ke liye

items.context: Aapko kis wajah se payment mein delay ho raha hai?
items.text: ji main apni payment thoda late karna chahta hoon kyunki merese waqt pe nahi ban payega

items.context: Kya aap payment split karwana chahte hain?
items.text: main thoda installment mein payment divide karna chahata hoon kyunki ek saath dena mushkil hai

items.context: Kya hum aapko payment date mein extension de sakte hain?
items.text: maine thoda financial problem face kar raha hoon to kya aap mera payment date extend kar denge

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: ask_extension - asks for more time or to split the payment
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
